assertions.name: abs_delta_net_eq_h_net_p
assertions.source: |Δ(net)| = h·net(p) — exact ℚ(q), the identity tying the binding dressing to Q_β

description: The deuteron binding dressing (1−h/2) is the proton single-wrap NF net coefficient net(p) (conj:borromean-quark). Exact ℚ(q) chain: Δ(net) = −h·net(p); |Δ(net)| = h·net(p); Q_β = E₀·h·net(p); hence B_D = E₀·net(p)·Δtr = Q_β·Δtr/h. Ties the binding dressing to the β-decay (bar-odd) sector via the single factor h. The exact identities are the probe's content. The binding magnitude B_D vs AME is recorded as a NEGATIVE (owner ruling 2026-11-25, bean qou-xj4p): the 2026-07-04 +0.29% hit came only from the superseded grouped word under the excised Markov convention C (attribution: probes/probe_d_dressing_is_proton_net/attribution/); on the ruled inputs the raw-difference B_D misses AME by about -75%, because it is not normalised by tr_free. The binding magnitude is now reported on the corpus's live law, exactly binding_log_free_energy.py: B = E_0*log(|tr_free|/|tr_atom|) (about +27% for the deuteron). NOT wired.
